name: Camp Laughing Loon
description_short: A non-profit summer day camp for ages 6-12 on Little Ossipee Lake in East Waterboro, Maine, running since 1917. Campers take swimming and canoeing lessons and also do nature, drama, art and sports.
swim_waterfront_notes: Camp sits on Little Ossipee Lake, with water on three sides. Swimming and canoeing lessons are taught by certified instructors.
